title: acer tataricum subvar. incumbens
intro: Acer tataricum subvar. incumbens, commonly known as the Amur maple, is a plant species belonging to the family Sapindaceae. This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Amur maple include reducing inflammation and oxidative stress, improving cardiovascular health, and exerting antimicrobial and antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents responsible for these therapeutic actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties.
